acceptance_tests.name: projection consumer suite
acceptance_tests.pass_condition: unittest OK including the mutation gate

acceptance_tests.name: sarf eval runner all-bank mode
acceptance_tests.pass_condition: exit 0 with the terminal line SARF EVAL RUNNER PASS

acceptance_tests.name: sarf eval runner unit suite
acceptance_tests.pass_condition: unittest OK (all mutation/negative gates still catch a broken consumer)

acceptance_tests.name: candidate/public boundary
acceptance_tests.pass_condition: the report line reads 'candidate/projector/public boundary: verified'

adversarial.expectation: a flat or draft public payload must FAIL this row, not pass it

positive.expectation: the subject-pronoun suffix segment is decided from the projection, not assumed

candidate_population.selection_rule: both banks in full, in file order; andon bank first, aggressive bank second

commands.purpose: validate the committed projection fixture once it exists

defeaters: A generic colour class or a present hover is not a satisfied segment requirement.
A root that appears in the hover text is not an asserted root fact.
A single final consonant may be a radical, so a suffix segment must be evidenced, not assumed.
Two appearances of one canonical occurrence must consume one projection; a second fork is a defect.
definition_of_done: every one of the 84 rows is decided or carries an exact blocker
both bank rows in the contract are updated with measured pins
no private, staging or live path entered the repository

conditions: a row expected segmentation cannot be produced from committed repository data
a projection would require a private or staging path
two appearances of one occurrence disagree
escalation_trigger.route: stop and write the unresolved rows with exact blockers to the packet report; hand back to the sarf lane owner

evidence_policy.fabrication_rule: If a row projection is not derivable from committed repository data, mark it unresolved with an exact blocker; never invent a segmentation to make the row pass.
evidence_policy.statement: Qurʾanic surfaces are reproduced byte-exactly and never altered; no external gloss, commentary or translation text may enter the fixture.

expected_outputs.description: Committed, source-clean projection sample the consumer reads instead of a staging artifact.
Consumer that decides expected_segments and reject_if against the projection sample.
Red-first suite with a mutation gate proving a wrong projection fails.

guards: Only the METHOD transfers: this packet fixes procedure, guards and acceptance tests and never pre-writes a linguistic conclusion for the executor to copy.
A reject_if entry must actually be rejected: a row that only checks presence is not a behavioural gate.
Segment surfaces must concatenate byte-exactly to the display surface.
The four sarf@2.1-@2.4 increments stay CANDIDATE and may not be cited as released authority.

This packet authorizes NO certification, NO rule promotion and NO public output: it may extend the runner, its tests, the shared harness wiring and the golden-command documentation, while the eval banks, the rule store, the skill registries, the projector ledger and the certification store stay immutable.
Re-run the candidate/projector/public boundary check with the full run (a targeted --bank run renders it not_checked and never claims it verified).

non_deployment.statement: Nothing in this packet mutates a live surface, an entry store or a whitelist. All outputs are candidate-mode repository artifacts; certification stays with the canonical certifier.

out_of_scope: Do not add a live path, a staging path or any private artifact to the repository.
Do not author learner-facing gloss text.
Do not modify the renderer or any website artifact.
scope.summary: vn00-public-visual-andon.jsonl (64 rows) and vn00-aggressive-false-closure.jsonl (20 rows) declare the segments a rich hover must surface for a real Qurʾanic address. Their intended consumer is the rich-hover projection plane, which needs a staging artifact that is not in this repository, so both banks are candidate_no_consumer and only structurally gated. Define a committed, source-clean projection fixture and a consumer that decides these rows from it.

title: Give the 84 VN-00 hover rows a runnable in-repo consumer
